name: Multi-Modal Joint Retrieval (Image + Text Query Embedding Fusion)
description: In e-commerce search, users submit a photo and a text clarification (e.g. photo of dress + 'in floral silk'). We compute a weighted combination of image-vector and text-vector similarity.
prompt:
In e-commerce search, users submit a photo and a text clarification (e.g. photo of dress + 'in floral silk'). We compute a weighted combination of image-vector and text-vector similarity.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: item_id, title, img_sim, txt_sim, joint_multimodal_score.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Joint multi-modal score: 60% image vector similarity + 40% text vector similarity
            SELECT 
                item_id,
                title,
                ROUND(array_cosine_similarity(img_vec, [0.82, 0.18]::FLOAT[2]), 4) AS img_sim,
                ROUND(array_cosine_similarity(txt_vec, [0.92, 0.08]::FLOAT[2]), 4) AS txt_sim,
                ROUND(
                    0.60 * array_cosine_similarity(img_vec, [0.82, 0.18]::FLOAT[2]) +
                    0.40 * array_cosine_similarity(txt_vec, [0.92, 0.08]::FLOAT[2]), 4
                ) AS joint_multimodal_score
            FROM fashion_items
            ORDER BY joint_multimodal_score DESC;
why_it_fails: Treating text and image vectors as independent queries yields conflicting rank lists.
